address: 599/3-4 Mu 2, Chaeng Sanit Road, Nai Mueang, Ban Phai, Khon Kaen, 40110, Thailand
bio: With more than 40 years of history, this eatery is now run by the second generation. Locals still frequent it for delicious, budget-friendly meals and cheerful service. The highlights here are the lap dishes and the spicy clear soup with beef and beef offal....
